statement: The conormal module I_{Z_ev}/I_{Z_ev}^2 is locally free of rank 4 although Fit_0(coker phi) is locally generated by the 6 pullbacks of local generators of I_e; the excess 2 equals the corank of da_N : T_Gamma Conf_6(C) -> T_e Pic^0(C), whose rank is identically 6 - h^0(O_C(D)) = 4 along Z_ev. Hence Z_ev is everywhere a local complete intersection of codimension 4 and nowhere cut out by a regular sequence of length 6.
justification: Step 5: regularity of a closed immersion of smooth k-schemes gives the conormal rank; the generator count is (T4) of ATT-0048; the Abel-Jacobi differential is the connecting map of 0 -> O_C -> O_C(Gamma) -> O_Gamma(Gamma) -> 0 with cokernel H^1(O_C(Gamma)) of dimension h^0(omega_C - Gamma) = h^0(O_C(D)) = 2 for Gamma in |omega_C - D|. The lci conclusion is drawn from this local computation, not from the numerical excess comparison (which the recorded constraint correctly says is insufficient).
